verdict: Yes, as a café or kiosk business. Boba Bhai pitched bubble tea on Shark Tank India Season 4 and got a deal. Bubble tea is popular with young people in cities, and each cup sells at a good margin, but rent, staff and imported tapioca pearls make costs add up.
angle: Young buyers in cities love bubble tea, and outlets near colleges and malls do well. It is a café business more than a packaged drink, so location and speed of service matter. Delivery apps add sales but take commission.

faq_extra.q: How much does a bubble tea outlet cost to open?
faq_extra.a: A kiosk usually costs ₹5–10 lakh for equipment, fit-out and deposits; a small sit-down café costs ₹15–30 lakh. Joining a franchise adds an upfront fee, and you'll need working capital for the first few months.
